name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
benefit_text_en: 100% free industry-aligned skill certification, boarding/lodging support for eligible candidates, and direct post-training placement facilitation.
benefit_text_hi: 100% नि:शुल्क उद्योग-आधारित कौशल प्रमाणन, भोजन/आवास सहायता और सीधे प्लेसमेंट की सुविधा।
eligibility_text: Indian youth aged 15-45, school/college dropouts or unemployed seeking industry skills.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2)
benefit_text_en: Monthly stipend sharing by Government (25% up to ₹1,500/month) alongside employer stipend, giving hands-on enterprise training and NAC certification.
benefit_text_hi: मासिक वजीफे में सरकार द्वारा सहायता (25% तक अधिकतम ₹1,500/माह), ऑन-द-जॉब ट्रेनिंग और राष्ट्रीय शिक्षुता प्रमाणपत्र (NAC)।
eligibility_text: Minimum 5th/8th/10th/12th/ITI pass candidates aged 14+ years (18+ for hazardous industries).

name: Craftsmen Training Scheme (CTS - ITI)
benefit_text_en: Standardised national vocational training across 150+ trades with highly subsidised fees in Government ITIs, leading to globally recognised NCVT certificates.
benefit_text_hi: 150+ ट्रेड्स में सरकारी आईटीआई में न्यूनतम शुल्क पर मानकीकृत राष्ट्रीय व्यावसायिक प्रशिक्षण और वैश्विक मान्यता प्राप्त NCVT प्रमाणपत्र।
eligibility_text: Class 8th / 10th pass depending on the trade; age 14 years and above with no upper limit.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
benefit_text_en: Skill verification, 5-7 days basic training with ₹500/day stipend, modern toolkit incentive of ₹15,000, and collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹3,00,000 at 5% interest.
benefit_text_hi: कौशल सत्यापन, ₹500/दिन वजीफे के साथ बुनियादी प्रशिक्षण, ₹15,000 की टूलकिट प्रोत्साहन राशि, और 5% ब्याज पर ₹3 लाख तक का संपार्श्विक-मुक्त ऋण।
eligibility_text: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools in 18 notified family trades.

name: Jan Shikshan Sansthan (JSS)
benefit_text_en: Community-level vocational skills for non-literates, neo-literates and school dropouts in rural and semi-urban localities at nominal cost.
benefit_text_hi: ग्रामीण और अर्ध-शहरी क्षेत्रों में गैर-साक्षरों, नव-साक्षरों और स्कूल छोड़ने वालों के लिए न्यूनतम लागत पर समुदाय-स्तरीय कौशल।
eligibility_text: Non-literates, neo-literates, persons with basic schooling up to 12th class; priority for women, SC, ST, and OBC.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
benefit_text_en: Placement-linked skill training for rural poor youth with guaranteed minimum 70% placement, free food and accommodation during training.
benefit_text_hi: ग्रामीण गरीब युवाओं के लिए प्लेसमेंट-लिंक्ड कौशल प्रशिक्षण जिसमें न्यूनतम 70% प्लेसमेंट की गारंटी और प्रशिक्षण के दौरान मुफ्त भोजन और आवास शामिल है।
eligibility_text: Rural youth aged 15-35 years from poor families (up to 45 years for women, PwD, and special groups).

name: SANKALP (Skill Acquisition and Knowledge Awareness)
benefit_text_en: World Bank assisted initiative for district-level skill planning, quality assurance, and inclusion of marginalized communities into formal skill ecosystems.
benefit_text_hi: जिला-स्तरीय कौशल नियोजन, गुणवत्ता आश्वासन और औपचारिक कौशल पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र में हाशिए पर मौजूद समुदायों को शामिल करने की पहल।
eligibility_text: District skill development beneficiaries and institutional training candidates.
